findings.headline: Migrate this from call to the memo-consumed async iterable form.
findings.why: Solid 2.0.0-rc.21 keeps from but changes its contract: instead of returning a signal, from(source) returns an async iterable that a memo consumes, as in createMemo(() => from(source)); the source closes when the memo re-runs or its owner is disposed, a subscribe-function source receives a next value rather than a setter callback, and under SSR the memo's ssrSource option decides how the source is read.
findings.guidance: Read the source argument and every consumer of the returned signal. Wrap the call as createMemo(() => from(source)) and read the memo where the signal was read, confirm a setter-style producer such as set(prev => ...) is rewritten to compute the value itself, and review SSR behavior for subscriptions or never-ending iterables.

findings.headline: Migrate this observable call to an effect that pushes to the external subscriber.
findings.why: Solid 2.0.0-rc.21 removes observable (signal-to-observable bridge) with no drop-in replacement; a createEffect that pushes signal changes to the external subscriber replaces it.
findings.guidance: Read the signal argument and every subscriber to the returned observable. Replace with a split createEffect whose compute callback reads the signal and whose apply callback pushes the value to the subscriber, returning any unsubscribe cleanup.
